We continued to accelerate on the priorities of our Solvay One Planet sustainability roadmap in 2022. This included 
strengthening bonds with our stakeholders — our customers, employees, investors, suppliers, local communities and the planet 
(governments and NGOs). We listened to their needs and built on their feedback, raising the bar to address our collective impact 
on climate change, natural resources and quality of life. This included working with customers and suppliers to reduce our carbon 
footprint and developing collaborations to create more sustainable and circular solutions.
